meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: Claude 探索代码时会改用 smart_search、smart_outline、smart_unfold 三个工具，替代 Read、Grep、Glob：先搜到相关文件和符号，再看文件结构，最后只展开需要的那段源码。
howto.when: 当你需要了解代码结构、查找函数或探索代码库时触发，此时它会接管默认探索行为，替代 Read、Grep、Glob。

say.text: 在 ./src 里搜一下 shutdown 相关的符号
say.note: 会跨文件返回排序后的符号和文件结构概览

say.text: 给我 services/worker-service.ts 的结构骨架
say.note: 只列函数、类、方法等符号，不读全部源码

say.text: 把 worker-service.ts 里 shutdown 的完整源码展开
say.note: 只取出这一个符号的完整实现

howto.what_en: Claude explores code with smart_search, smart_outline and smart_unfold instead of Read, Grep and Glob: search to find files and symbols, outline a file's structure, then unfold only the symbol you need.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase; while active it overrides default exploration behavior.

say_en.text: Search ./src for symbols related to shutdown
say_en.note: Returns ranked symbols and folded file views

say_en.text: Show me the outline of services/worker-service.ts
say_en.note: Lists functions, classes and methods, no full source

say_en.text: Unfold the full source of shutdown in worker-service.ts
